summary: Mistral released version 2.25.0 of its Vibe CLI/agent tool, adding connector and MCP plugin support, skills browsing, prompt queueing controls, numerous bug fixes, and removing Devstral Small from the default models list.

practices.reason: A model is removed from the default list, requiring teams pinned to it to migrate their configuration.
practices.quote: Devstral Small (`devstral-small-latest`) from the default models list; stale sparse config overrides migrated automatically

practices.reason: New first-party connectors and plugin-declared MCP servers add integration surfaces a team could choose to wire into their agent, but nothing is required to change today.
practices.quote: Connectors (Notion, Linear, Slack, GitHub, Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive) in ACP
